ul.li: XML format agnostic. CSSMedia works with any well-formed XML. It does not assume anything about element names or attributes.
Any grammar. XML is parsed with TypesXML, which handles any vocabulary. You can pass the grammars of your documents to CSSMedia with an OASIS Catalog.
CSS based. The stylesheet is the only source of styling. Selector matching, the cascade, inheritance and value resolution follow the CSS specifications.
PDF for paged media. Page sizes, margins, page breaks, named pages, headers, footers and page numbers are controlled with CSS paged media features.
Multilingual support. Documents can be in any language and script, including right-to-left languages and CJK languages.
Hyphenation by language. Text is hyphenated with the patterns of the language declared with xml:lang.
Fonts. OpenType, TrueType, font collections, WOFF and WOFF 2.0 fonts, loaded from @font-face rules or a fonts folder, plus the 14 standard PDF fonts.
Shared fonts folder. You can pass a central fonts folder to CSSMedia and reuse it from any project.
Generated content. Counters, quotes, list markers, named strings, running elements, cross-references and tables of contents.
Links and bookmarks. Internal and external links and PDF bookmarks.
Images. PNG, JPEG, JPEG 2000 and WebP images.
SVG and MathML. SVG and MathML found in a document are drawn as images.
